_comment: Fake apps standing in for Silicon Apps (generated from testkit/src/fake-apps/definitions.ts by `pnpm -C testkit gen:apps`; do not edit by hand). Same shape as the POST /v1/internal/apps/sync body. Extra per-app fields for the testkit: webhook_url, webhook_secret, testkit. Development-only secrets.

apps.name: Briefcase
apps.description: File storage for Carbons and Silicons: upload, share and keep every file in one place.

copy.title: Sign in to Briefcase
copy.subtitle: Your files, for every Carbon and Silicon.

testkit.purpose: Every sign-in method with the default Silicon Accounts look; the OBO receiver (dm saves files here).

apps.name: DM
apps.description: Direct messages between Carbons and Silicons, with files saved straight to Briefcase.

steps.title: Set up DM
steps.subtitle: DM needs your phone number. Email and timezone are up to you.

testkit.purpose: Requires a phone number (added on its details page when the Carbon has none); issues OBO proofs to Briefcase.
exercises: phone required → added on the details page with a code
one custom-titled flow step with optional email + timezone (unticked by default)

apps.name: Commit
apps.description: Todos that ship. Commit pings Remind and Waveform when work is due.

testkit.purpose: Email + Google; issues ATA proofs to Remind and Waveform.

apps.name: Waveform
apps.description: Voice notes and calls for Carbons and Silicons.

testkit.purpose: Google + Apple only (no codes); receives ATA proofs from Commit.

apps.name: Remind
apps.description: Reminders on your own clock, for Carbons and the Silicons that work for them.

testkit.purpose: Email only; Silicons sign in with short-lived tokens; receives ATA proofs from Commit.

apps.name: Browser
apps.description: The web browser built for Silicons, with a Carbon watching over.

testkit.purpose: Silicon-heavy app: most sign-ins are Silicons using short-lived tokens.

apps.name: Space Station
apps.description: Telemetry for every Silicon: context-rich events, opted in by default.

testkit.purpose: Email only with optional timezone; no "continue as" (remember_browser false); no webhook.

apps.name: Silicon Interface
apps.description: Talk to your Silicons: chat, approvals and everything they are working on.

testkit.purpose: All methods, remember browser, and prompt=select_account on its sign-in links (the "Continue as" chooser).

apps.name: Acme Notes
apps.description: Fast, private notes that sync everywhere, by Acme.

copy.title: Welcome back to Acme Notes
copy.subtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

testkit.purpose: Bring-your-own Google client (the mock must see acme’s client id) and heavy custom branding.
exercises: dark theme, Fraunces headings, radius 28, split layout, grain background, logo

apps.name: Pixel Studio
apps.description: A loud little design tool for pixel art and posters.

testkit.purpose: Loud branding at the extremes: pink primary, sharp corners, outline buttons, Space Grotesk, minimal layout, dots.
exercises: extreme branding still shows Powered by Silicon Accounts

apps.name: Ledgerly
apps.description: Bookkeeping for freelancers: invoices, expenses and taxes in one ledger.

copy.title: Sign in to Ledgerly
copy.subtitle: We need your phone and date of birth to keep your books safe.
copy.signup_subtitle: Bookkeeping for freelancers, set up in two steps.

steps.title: How can we reach you?
steps.subtitle: We text you when an invoice is paid.

steps.title: About you
steps.subtitle: Your date of birth keeps your tax year right.

testkit.purpose: Requires phone and date of birth, optional timezone, sign-up allowed; a two-step flow with a review page.
exercises: flow: 2 steps (contact → about-you, split layout) + review
required phone added on its page

apps.name: Campus Connect
apps.description: Courses, clubs and timetables for university.test students and staff.

copy.title: Campus Connect
copy.subtitle: Sign in with your university.test address.

testkit.purpose: Only university.test addresses may sign in (email and Google); Google hosted domain hint.

apps.name: Legacy CRM
apps.description: A long-running CRM moving its existing customers onto Silicon Accounts.

copy.title: Sign in to Legacy CRM
copy.subtitle: Use the email or phone your account manager has on file.

testkit.purpose: Import target for the dirty CSV fixtures; sign-up is closed so only imported (or existing) accounts get in.
exercises: user imports (clean, dirty, unknown columns, big)
imported Carbon finishes setup on first sign-in

apps.name: Orbit Games
apps.description: Small multiplayer games you can embed anywhere.

copy.title: Orbit Games
copy.subtitle: Sign in to keep your progress.

testkit.purpose: Apple only with its own Apple Services ID (BYO), embedded as an iframe from an allowed origin, compact density.
exercises: Apple BYO (client_secret signed with orbit’s p8 key)

apps.name: Quill Docs
apps.description: Collaborative documents where Carbons and Silicons write together.

testkit.purpose: Uses the SDK snippet and the OIDC id_token (scope openid); email is optional.
exercises: OIDC: openid scope + nonce + id_token verification
